settings.title: Settings
settings.clickToConfirm: Click again to confirm, or press another combination
settings.restoreClipboardTextOnlyHint: Text clipboard only; images, files, and rich content are not fully restored yet.
settings.streamingInsert: Write AI text as it generates
settings.sttSignInHint: Sign in and subscribe to Pro to use official cloud words/month.
settings.sttUpgradeHint: Upgrade to Pro for cloud words/month across 99 languages. No API key needed.
settings.sttProActive: Pro active — millisecond STT, 99 languages. No API key needed.
settings.customSttSetupHint: Start your local OpenAI-compatible STT server first, then test the connection here.
settings.customSttFallbackApiKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank to reuse the primary API key
settings.customSttFallbackApiKeyHint: Only fill in if the fallback endpoint needs a different key
settings.customSttFallbackHint: When the primary endpoint fails (including timeout), the request is retried against this fallback. Leave blank to disable.
settings.customSttRequestTimeoutHint: Counted from the end of recording. On timeout the fallback endpoint (if configured) is used.
settings.volcengineSttKeyHint: Use a Volcengine Speech API key, or app_id:access_token from the old console. Ark LLM keys are separate.
settings.aliyunQwenRegionHint: Use the region where your DashScope API key was created. Keys are region-specific.
settings.customSttConnectionFailed: Local STT server is not reachable. Check that it is running and the port is correct.
settings.llmSignInHint: Sign in and subscribe to Pro to use cloud AI polish. No API key needed.
settings.llmUpgradeHint: Upgrade to Pro for cloud AI polish and monthly usage. No API key needed.
settings.llmProActive: Pro active — cloud AI polish is ready. No API key needed.
settings.storedLocally: Stored locally on your device. Never sent to OpenTypeless servers.
settings.credentialSaveFailed: Could not save API key to OS vault. {{details}}
settings.modelBestEffort: Context and thought-aware support is best effort
settings.enableAiPolishDesc: Cleans up fillers, punctuation, and wording before output. Turn off to output raw transcription.
settings.contextAdaptation: Adapt writing to the current app
settings.contextAdaptationHint: Uses a private local app category to shape the writing style.
settings.browserAccessHint: Allow browser access to use Gmail, Docs, and Slack Web modes.
settings.askAnythingDesc: Voice question, one-shot answer. No chat history.
settings.translationModeDesc: Translates each dictation result into the target language below.
settings.selectedTextContextDesc: Lets Ask and polish summarize, rewrite, or translate selected text. Uses more AI tokens.
settings.aboutDescription: Open-source AI voice input tool. Speak to write — turn your voice into polished text in real time.
settings.historyPrivacyHint: Set days to 0 to keep history by count only. History stays local.
settings.accessibilityRequired: Required for Fn shortcut or keyboard output
settings.waylandHotkeyLimited: Global hotkeys are limited on Wayland. Use the tray or app button if this shortcut does not respond.
settings.hotkeyRegistrationFailed: Shortcut could not be registered in this session.
settings.hotkeyConflict: Dictation and Ask shortcuts cannot be the same.
settings.hotkeyInvalid: One shortcut is invalid. Record a new key combination.
settings.waylandClipboardCopyOnly: On Wayland, clipboard mode copies text only. Paste manually to avoid system permission prompts.
settings.advancedPolishSettingsDesc: Optional writing rules for AI polish
settings.customPolishInstructionsPlaceholder: Optional: keep a concise tone, preserve domain terms, or follow your team style.
settings.advancedIntro: Power-user overrides for the BYOK request layer. Leave a field empty to keep the built-in behaviour; nothing here is required for the app to work.
settings.advancedAskMaxTokensHint: Reasoning models spend thinking tokens from this same budget. Anything below ~1000 will silently return an empty answer.
settings.advancedAskTimeoutHint: Cold OpenRouter routes can take 30s+. Errors out with a timeout message instead of a silent retry.
settings.advancedAskPromptHint: When non-empty this fully replaces the built-in prompt. Include your own language and length rules.
settings.advancedPromptPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the built-in prompt
settings.advancedPolishMaxTokensHint: Budget for the dictation output. Long recordings need several thousand tokens.
settings.advancedLlmTimeoutHint: Applies to the streaming polish/translate request. Ask keeps its own timeout above.
settings.advancedPolishPromptAppendHint: Appended under [ADVANCED_USER_INSTRUCTIONS]; it cannot override fidelity or output-only rules.
settings.advancedNoteStt: Transcription requests are multipart uploads, so there is no JSON body to merge — STT parameters are intentionally not exposed.
settings.advancedNoteAnthropic: Overrides are merged into the request body, so they work for both OpenAI-compatible endpoints (incl. OpenRouter) and native Anthropic /messages.
settings.advancedNoteSharedModel: Ask and polish share the model, provider, base URL and API key from Settings → AI Polish; only budgets, prompts and parameters differ here.
settings.advancedFixJson: Fix the JSON request parameters before saving
settings.advancedResetHint: Advanced fields reset to defaults — remember to save

recordingLimits.allowedCloudRange: Range: {{min}}–{{max}}. Set by the current Cloud capability.
recordingLimits.providerFixedLimit: This provider allows recordings up to {{max}}.
recordingLimits.deadlineWarning: Recording will stop automatically in {{seconds}} seconds.
recordingLimits.deadlineReached: Recording limit reached ({{duration}}). Your audio is being submitted. {{reason}}

reasons.providerDuration: Limited by this provider’s maximum recording duration.
reasons.appleSpeech: Limited by Apple Speech’s on-device recognition session.
reasons.clientBuffer: Limited by the app’s safe local audio buffer.
reasons.unknownUpstream: The custom server’s limit is unknown; a conservative default is used.
reasons.unknownProvider: This provider is not yet recognized; a safe fallback is used.
reasons.productSafety: A conservative app limit for this streaming provider.
reasons.encoderFallback: The managed audio encoder was unavailable, so this session used the shorter local WAV-safe limit.
reasons.managedFallback: Cloud capability is unavailable or stale, so the safe 30-second limit is used.
